# Storyboard — every beat, every section

**Generated by `npm run board`. Do not edit by hand.**

A hand-written board drifts from the code within a day, and then two
documents disagree about what the video is. This one is read out of each
section's `beats.ts`, so the board and the build are the same fact.

Chain check: `npm run check:chain` · Frames: `npm run frames:all`
